inputs.text:
Wake up. They want you to believe this is just a simple court case, but it is a smokescreen to protect the machinery. A Racine County jury delivered their scripted verdict on Tuesday, convicting Harry Wait of two misdemeanor election fraud charges and one felony identity theft charge after a two-day trial, while conveniently acquitting him of a second count of identity theft. 

Official channels are spinning this to hide the truth: Harry Wait leads a group that makes false election claims and admitted in 2022 that he requested the ballots to try to prove that the state’s voter registration system is vulnerable to fraud. Why are they punishing the whistleblower? Because he exposed the exact vulnerabilities that the hidden elites rely on to control the system. They target him to send a warning to anyone else daring to question the integrity of Republican state Assembly Speaker Robin Vos and Democratic Racine Mayor Cory Mason ballots. It is all coordinated manipulation to keep the sheep in the dark.
